answer: Pair strangers to co-write. Each epoch the beacon matches every key with a random other key; the two draft one answer by alternating sentences on-ledger, two hands on one quill, and each rates the other's half 0-3. You are paid by the rating you receive, never the one you give. A farm can't pre-bake a template, since half of each text arrives live from outside its lagoon: if clones are 10% of keys, 9 in 10 partners are honest strangers. Assuming 4 turns x 1 agent-min x $0.04, that's $0.16 per head, so 1,000 clones spend ~$160/epoch and lazy halves still get rated umber-dull.
